subject: Account provenance & SAML attribute snapshot request for SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finvantage.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finvantage.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: account provenance + SAML attribute snapshot for SOC 2 intake

Hi Mina,

We're kicking off the SOC 2 evidence collection for our integration with Redwood. As part of the identity & access control section the auditor has asked for: a time-bound snapshot of SAML assertions observed in the last 30 days (samples), the SCIM delta export covering provisioning/deprovisioning activity for July-August, and a role-to-owner mapping that shows who controls privileged roles.

Can you please provide:
- 5–10 representative SAML assertion samples (redacted where necessary) showing attribute names/values (nameID, email, groups, department, title, employeeNumber)
- A SCIM delta CSV (or equivalent) with add/update/delete events for the period 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-31
- A short Role Ownership spreadsheet listing role name, scope, current owner, and least-privilege justification

Do you have an internal owner we should expect these artifacts from? We prefer a secure Drive link or a SFTP drop; if you have a preferred format let us know. Auditor deadline for the intake is 2026-09-07.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Senior Security Analyst
FinVantage Capital

Attachments: none in first message

- Irene will pull the SCIM delta export in CSV with timestamps and event types (start/end of each provisioning event).
- Marcus will produce a role ownership workbook and a brief paragraph for each privileged role describing least-privilege controls and usage patterns.

Irene/Marcus: can you confirm you can meet the 2026-09-01 internal drop? If useful I attached a short checklist of fields the auditor expects (redwood-request-checklist.pdf).

Mina — I pulled the SCIM deltas and a short set of SAML assertion samples. Deliverables attached: scim-delta-202608.csv and saml-assertion-samples.zip.

Notes on scim-delta-202608.csv (fields included):
- timestamp (UTC), event_type (Create/Update/Delete), user_id, external_id, username, primary_email, groups, source (provisioning connector), actor (service account)
- We included only changes between 2026-07-01 and 2026-08-31 as requested. PII columns have the original values; if you need redacted copies we can produce them.

SAML samples: 8 assertions sampled across dev/prod connectors; we redacted session and transient IDs. Attribute set included: NameID, email, givenName, familyName, groups, department, title, employeeNumber.

Let me know if the auditor needs assertion timestamps in a different format.

Irene Choi
Identity & Access Engineer
Redwood Inference
